mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate compresses the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. This mechanism is active whenever the rate is observed, without additional regime conditions.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 60-day S&P 500 returns is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant monthly decline in non-farm payroll employment signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings deterioration and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS declines > 0.5% in 1 month, or the Rank IC for PAYEMS as a predictor is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures signal a synchronized weakening in consumer and housing demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has a Rank IC below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or negative returns do not occur in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, rising industrial production signals overheating and impending monetary tightening, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO rises > 0.3% in 1 month, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in late-cycle regimes is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of real personal consumption expenditures indicates strong consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for RSAFS as a predictor of 20-day S&P 500 returns is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A significant monthly rise in the consumer price index signals accelerating inflation, which typically triggers monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3% in 1 month, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL as a predictor is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and declines in payroll employment signal a severe labor market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (UNRATE * PAYEMS) has a Rank IC below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or negative returns do not occur in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and PAYEMS declines > 0.3% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In post-shock recovery periods, rising industrial production indicates a rebound in supply capacity, which supports corporate profits and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In post-shock recovery periods, S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO rises > 0.3% in 1 month, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in post-shock regimes is below 0.02.
